svg.title: spleeterpt model architecture
svg.desc: Stereo STFT magnitudes feed independent six-level U-Nets, one per stem. Raw encoder convolutions provide five skip concatenations. A raw bottleneck feeds six upconvolutions; the first three use dropout. Two-channel logits become magnitude estimates, then squared-magnitude ratio masks applied to the complex mixture STFT before Hann overlap-add synthesis. Two/four-stem presets use sigmoid; five stems use softmax across stems.
svg.title: spleeterpt model architecture
